=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1471 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: No correctness defect found in the updated jq candidate-set filter and tier-2 narrowing; the interlock is sound.
  WHY: The in_progress + created_at <= BAIT_CREATED_AT condition means the run was in flight when the bait landed, and the historical stale-review false match remains excluded.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:81,334 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The REVIEW_TIMEOUT default bump is a pure default change, not a contract break.
  WHY: Explicit `review_timeout` / `phase_timeout` inputs still override the fallback chain, so callers are unaffected.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1471 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The tier-2 versus tier-3 selection preference looks inconsistent, but it is intentional rather than a bug.
  WHY: Tier 2 specifically targets the original long-running PR-open review, while tier 3 is a generic fallback.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~1460-1468 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The tier-2 fallback can latch onto an unrelated in_progress run because it relies on created_at ordering alone and is not robust against cancellation or pagination gaps.
  WHY: If the original lock-holder is cancelled or missing from the paginated result, the activity timer can track the wrong run and miss the actual bait-review execution.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~1468-1474 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The tier-2 jq selector is not explicitly constrained to the $m candidate set, so it can theoretically pull an older run that was excluded by the outer select.
  WHY: With many historical branch runs, the inner map can choose a run outside the intended candidate set and prevent the fallback chain from reaching the true candidate.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
